rows.en: Waruderrr!
With those words, Waruder, the android with a samurai's heart, vanished from Zero-One and the others. What became of the lone swordsman after that, no one knows.
But a few hours after Waruder disappeared… there was a huge explosion of unknown cause on a certain uninhabited island, and a later investigation reported that a Shadow-related facility had blown up.

(Waruder is dead…

Waruder, who was so kind, is dead…

I'll live with a righteous heart, for your share too.

Somehow I can feel… your warmth in my heart. I'll keep fighting with it from now on. Goodbye, Waruder…)
What!? The Robot Regenerator? Did Shadow Knight really say that?
Yes, Doctor…
Don't tell me… the Robot Regenerator is yours, Father?
Yes, that's right. It's certainly a machine Shadow forced me to build.
Then… can Shadow really regenerate robots endlessly?
Good grief… Then we don't stand a chance.
No, we do…
What!?

I built a self-destruct device into the Robot Regenerator!

Once that machine regenerates thirty robots, the Shadow base will automatically blow sky-high!
The Shadow base will blow up?

That's right…

If you defeat thirty robots, you can destroy the Great World Crime Organization Shadow itself!
Ichiro, let's go!
But this is Big Shadow we're talking about… There's no telling what tricks he has set up. Mari, you could die!
Yes…

Wait!

I can't let you two go alone, Brother!
All right… Even if two of the three of us are killed, as long as one survives, we'll manage somehow.
Yes…

There is one more!

This life, which I have already thrown away once… I entrust to you, Lord Zero-One!
I don't think of you as robots! Please, don't throw your lives away…
Doctor…

Hold on a second!

I've been waiting for you to ask us… Were you planning to leave us behind?
Please, let us help too…
But… as I said a moment ago, there is no guarantee you will survive!
So what?
Heh heh… Waruder, once [HERO2] says something, there's no use trying to stop him.
I do not understand… Why would you go so far as to take such a risk?

Because we're comrades…

We're comrades, aren't we… That's why we're going! That's what comrades are!
[HERO2]…
Comrades…

All right, I won't stop you anymore! Go!

But listen… I won't stand for you coming back beaten! Got that?
Yes!
Big Shadow! Come out!

Hahaha…

So you've come, Kikaider, Zero-One, Bijinder… heh heh… and Waruder!

Our Great World Crime Organization Shadow has at last decided to use its ultimate weapon… the Robot Regenerator! First, let me show you its power!
Shadow Knight… has really been regenerated!?

Heh heh heh… How's that? Shadow's robots can come back no matter how many times they're destroyed!

Shadow can no longer be destroyed. Our Shadow will conquer the world! Heh heh heh… Hahahaha!
I won't let you, Big Shadow!

Heh heh heh… Rampage! Rampage as much as you like and use up all your energy!

We have this Regenerator! The Shadowmen will come back to life as many times as it takes! Go!
All right, go!
All right, go!
Nngh… All right, go!
You again!? Nuooh… Go!
What are you doing!? Do it right! I won't regenerate you next time! All right, go!
Kill them all! Go!
I'll regenerate you as many times as it takes! All right, go!
Mmh… You again? Don't slack off, go!
Kill theeem! Kill Zero-One and the rest, every last one! Go!
Kill them this time! Kill them all!
I'm counting on you… Go!
